description:
Free premium plugin manifest builder. Generates a strict, data-only stream/webhook/tool manifest template that teams can place in a private plugin subrepo, validate, plug, and unplug without executing untrusted code or exposing provider secrets.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Build Premium Plugin Template input schema. Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

capabilityId.description: Lowercase capability id, for example custom.signal.stream or custom:tool:score.

capabilityType.description: Capability type to template: stream, webhook, or tool.

description.description: Full agent-facing description explaining the use case, provider boundary, pricing model, and what the capability delivers.

pluginId.description: Lowercase premium plugin id, for example sap-premium-custom-alpha. This becomes the manifest id.

providerEnv.description: Uppercase provider env var names required to make the capability live. Do not pass secret values.

items.description: Environment variable name, for example SAP_MCP_PREMIUM_CUSTOM_STREAM_URL.

publisher.description: Publisher name used for enterprise review and marketplace metadata.

title.description: Human-readable plugin and capability title shown to agent runtimes.

unitPriceUsd.description: Suggested x402/pay.sh unit price in USD. Agents should see pricing before activation.

visibility.description: Discovery visibility. Use private or enterprise for non-public provider contracts.

name: sap_premium_plugin_template

nextSteps.description: Operator steps for validating, plugging, unplugging, and safely exposing this plugin.

validation.description: Validation report for the generated template.
